summary: Leecher's summit has held a crow's nest, a windmill tower and a 1954 timber tower with an L-4 cab; the lookout stands restored and is reached by a short hike.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 40-41 ft timber tower (1954); earlier windmill tower and crow's nest on the same summit

access.note: Hike from a locked gate on Road 100 (WTA). Parking pass: Northwest Forest Pass or America the Beautiful Pass. Sources do not say whether visitors may enter the cab.

visit.trail_note: Drive Benson Creek Drive about 10 miles to spur Road 100, then 3 miles to a parking area at a locked gate. Hike listed as 2.4 mi round trip with 531 ft gain (WTA).

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Okanogan National Forest, Methow Valley Ranger District)

events.note: Tree-top crow's nest, still standing about 1,000 ft south of the present tower. NHLR dates it 1920; firelookout.com and the Methow Valley FFLA say 1918
Windmill tower with 6x6 ft cab (about 45 ft per firelookout.com and the Methow Valley FFLA)
Living quarters beside the tower: log house per firelookout.com and the Methow Valley FFLA; ground house per NHLR
Log house replaced by an L-4 ground-house cab (NHLR gives 1941 for an L-4 on an 11-ft timber tower)
NHLR only: L-4 cab on an 11-ft timber tower built; windmill tower moved to Twisp Smokejumper Base for a training loft
Present timber tower with L-4 cab, cab brought from Chiliwist Butte Lookout
Windmill tower moved to a smokejumper base. Firelookout.com and the Methow Valley FFLA say the North Cascades base; NHLR says Twisp in 1941
Used for emergency summer fire detection from the 1980s
Bill Austin, 19 seasons at Goat Peak, posted to Leecher. WTA says a brief stint, moved back to Goat Peak before season end; the Methow Valley FFLA says he was evacuated by helicopter
Carlton Complex fire burned neighboring trees; lookout and crow's nest survived

corrections.why: 1.8 m fits no source. NHLR and firelookout.com give a 41-ft tower (12.5 m); WTA gives 40 ft (12.2 m).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Crow's nest dated 1918 by firelookout.com and the Methow Valley FFLA, and 1920 by NHLR. The current tower is 1954 in all three.
Current tower given as 41 ft by NHLR and firelookout.com, and 40 ft by the Methow Valley FFLA and WTA. The story says 40 or 41 feet and the corrected record uses 41 ft.
Windmill tower move: 1941 to the Twisp Smokejumper Base (NHLR) versus 1954 to the North Cascades base (firelookout.com, Methow Valley FFLA).
Log house replaced by an L-4 cab in 1936 (firelookout.com, Methow Valley FFLA) versus an L-4 on an 11-ft tower in 1941 (NHLR).

Firelookout.com says full-time staffing returned in 2010. WTA says a ranger may or may not be on the summit, and describes only a brief 2014 stint. The story reports both and records the 2014 date as the latest dated staffing.
The 2014 evacuation by helicopter appears only in the Methow Valley FFLA account. WTA says Austin was moved back to Goat Peak instead.

notes_for_editor: Record height 1.8 m is wrong; the tower is 40-41 ft. The Methow Valley News article linked from NHLR (story.php?id=3883) returned HTTP 404 in the cache, so it was not read. Staffing is the weakest part: the latest dated source is 2014, and WTA's undated note says a ranger may or may not be present. The 2014 helicopter evacuation is from the Methow Valley FFLA alone. The windmill-tower move and the 1936 versus 1941 cab date are unresolved between sources; the story states both.
